triage.desk_query: Term sheet G03 states: "Coupon amounts accrue on a Actual/360 day count basis." The booking record carries day_count = 30/360, which conflicts with the documented Actual/360 basis and will misstate accrued coupon amounts. Please confirm whether the booking should be corrected to ACT/360, or identify any executed amendment or supplement that supports 30/360. Response needed before the next coupon accrual calculation.
